instruction: Please configure VS Code to enable line numbers in the editor for the current user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to configure VS Code line numbers setting to 'on'. Evaluator checks the settings.json file for the correct key-value pair. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code user settings from standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric correctly verifies the required setting (editor.lineNumbers: on) exists in the JSON file
Expected value is semantically correct for enabling line numbers in VS Code
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
No postconfig needed: VS Code persists settings to disk automatically
Robust error handling: handles missing files and malformed JSON gracefully
